hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) WS=$(echo "$FILE" | grep -oE 'apps/(server|web)' | head -1); if [ -n "$WS" ]; then npx --prefix "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" -y tsc --noEmit -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$WS/tsconfig.json" >&2 || true; fi ;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm test
